purpose: Fixed reference board and construction ledger for the first 12 reviewed Aqua icons.
copyrightBoundary: Historical Apple artwork is research-only evidence. Production PNGs are original illustrated constructions; screenshot crops and extracted system artwork are never copied into runtime assets.

systemRules.sizePolicy: Runtime surfaces downscale the 128 px master. The ten programmatic cores own separately composed 32 px and 16 px review hints, never mechanical reductions; the two accepted Image Gen cores use separately processed ledger artifacts.
systemRules.light: One source above and slightly toward the viewer, with a narrow upper highlight and an object-owned contact shadow.
systemRules.perspective: Applications sit on a desk and widen toward the base; utilities face forward; documents hover; hardware retains physical weight.
systemRules.materials: Paper, painted plastic, brushed metal, chrome, glass, rubber, cloth, and wood keep distinct highlight widths and edge softness.
systemRules.alpha: Anti-aliased object edges and artwork-owned soft shadows; no CSS gloss, global filter, or shared rounded-square container.
systemRules.smallArt: At 32 px delete secondary texture and reinforce the silhouette. At 16 px move or merge details to preserve recognition rather than shrinking the master.
systemRules.toolbarBoundary: Finder and application artwork is not reused as toolbar art; the laboratory shows the separate 28 px Jaguar toolbar family.
systemRules.grid: Every object is placed on the shared icon grid in tooling/lib/icon-grid.mjs: one live dimension per shape class (square, portrait, landscape) with a margin that no object may cross, plus small optical allowances for shapes that read large or small at equal bounds. Objects are scaled uniformly, never stretched, so a row reads as one family while each object keeps its own proportions.

sources.use: Finder and Dock scale, icon-view spacing, hard-disk weight, early-Aqua chrome, and mixed application coexistence.
sources.redistribution: Copyrighted screenshots; local research and comparison only.

sources.use: Native 32 px evidence for folder, hard disk, trash, generic document, generic application, media, utilities, and application genres.
sources.redistribution: Historical system artwork; evidence-only and excluded from product packages.
